purpose: Use Optuna only to accelerate low-DOF discovery inside the already-authorized discovery period while retaining purged walk-forward and multiple-testing evidence.
eligible_family_rule: Only a genuinely new family with its own frozen feature/candidate contract may use this harness. Existing rejected or outcome-opened families may not be fed into it for rescue tuning.

time_policy.validation_after_selection: Freeze the selected configuration before opening later-period validation evidence.

fixed_before_search.feature_set: Supplied by a separate preregistered family spec; Optuna may not choose features.
fixed_before_search.candidate_universe: Supplied by a separate preregistered family spec.
fixed_before_search.cost_policy: All new discovery/performance metrics use transaction cost 0%. Historical 0.5%/1% outputs are legacy evidence only and may not rank candidates or determine GO/NO-GO.
fixed_before_search.entry_exit_semantics: Canonical next official XTKS session open to fifth official XTKS session close for comparable 5BD research.

search_v1.objective: Purged walk-forward out-of-sample per-active-date Sharpe of the fixed top-N cohort gross-return stream at transaction cost 0%.
search_v1.walk_forward: Date-grouped expanding walk-forward using purgedcv; label-horizon overlap must audit to zero.

promotion.rule: This contract validates research infrastructure only. A candidate still needs its own frozen family specification and locked later-period validation.
